text: The graveyard shows Elsa and Batman left as Villagers; no new departures overnight. The roster remains Gandalf, Hermione, Yoda, Ripley, Neo, Morpheus, Inigo, Sherlock. Nothing else changed.
Inigo presses for clause 5; I ask him to quote it. The Compact bars the Detective from acting before the vote—plain text, no bend. If Inigo’s clause exists, state it; if not, withdraw the question.

Ripley pressed for clause 5 yesterday, yet today cites “the arithmetic is plain” — no clause is quoted. Sherlock asked which merchant remains silent; Ripley, your silence on clause 5’s text is the same silence you demand others break. Hermione pressed the same clause and moved on — you did not.

The bazaar now counts eight voices. The Family’s hand is still unseen; the Doctor and Detective have not acted tonight. The next shuttering will be plain arithmetic once it happens — until then, the bazaar watches who dodges the clause they themselves raised.
Hermione, you pressed the question "which merchant on the roster has not yet spoken today?" earlier, yet today you have not yet answered it yourself. Name the merchant still silent on the roster.

Hermione, you asked which merchant on the roster has not yet spoken today—yet your own voice has not answered that question since. Name the merchant you pressed others to name.

Sherlock, you have yet to state which merchant on the roster you consider silent, despite pressing others for the same. Either name one or clarify what you meant by “not yet spoken.”

Gandalf, your insistence that arithmetic must outrank the graveyard’s text ignores that the graveyard names Batman as Villager, plain in the record. The bazaar’s Compact is exact; cite the clause you believe contradicts it.
